title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. translated_title: 图拓扑与能量驱动寻径的相遇：在检索增强生成中保持上下文一致性
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）经常集成知识图谱（KG）来完成复杂的多跳问答任务。然而，其性能日益受到知识构建与推理过程的瓶颈制约：（i）严重的语义损失：将连续文本提炼为离散符号会剥离上下文的细微差别与叙事连贯性；（ii）显著的模态失配：碎片化的图结构与大型语言模型（LLM）预训练所使用的连续文本相冲突，而将图结构重写为自然语言则会引入生成噪声并遗漏信息。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 ThreadRAG，一种基于语义拓扑的 RAG 框架，用于实现保持上下文的知识结构与模态原生的证据推理。ThreadRAG 引入了语义拓扑映射器（STM），它将检索到的文档组织为上下文完整的语义节点，并通过叙事、语义……
tldr: 提出 ThreadRAG 框架，通过语义拓扑映射器（STM）将检索文档组织为上下文完整的语义节点并构建语义拓扑图，结合能量驱动的路径搜索，解决知识图谱 RAG 中语义损失和模态失配两大瓶颈问题。
